userInput: Fix UI bug: Cannot blacklist boxes from mixins. When trying to hide 'Master Node 1' or 'VM 1' from ext_layers.yaml, other IDs are being considered as blacklisted ('id_1_1', 'id_1_2').

alternatives.name: Fix getBoxPrefix() logic
alternatives.description: Improve the ID extraction logic in getBoxPrefix() function (main.js:4077) to correctly parse hierarchical box IDs from SVG element IDs. The current function incorrectly strips non-numeric segments after the first numeric segment, causing 'id_1_l1_1_g' to extract as '1_1' instead of 'id_1_l1_1'.
pros: Most direct fix to the root cause
Improves ID extraction throughout the entire UI
Fixes both caption-based and ID-based blacklisting
cons: Requires careful testing to ensure regex/parsing doesn't break other ID formats
May have side effects on other ID extraction operations
Need to verify with various nested box hierarchies

alternatives.name: Add caption-to-ID lookup mapping
alternatives.description: Instead of relying on getBoxPrefix() to extract IDs from SVG elements, build a persistent caption-to-ID mapping during SVG rendering or load time. When user selects 'Master Node 1', look it up in the mapping to get 'id_1_l1_1' directly.
pros: More robust: decouples UI element IDs from box logic IDs
Handles edge cases where SVG element ID structure may vary
Makes caption-based selection more reliable across all box types
Could improve performance by avoiding regex parsing on every click
cons: Requires changes in WASM layer to expose the mapping
More complex implementation involving data structures
Need to keep mapping in sync as boxes are expanded/collapsed

alternatives.name: Store correct box ID in SVG element data attributes
alternatives.description: Modify the SVG rendering layer (pkg/svg/drawing.go or pkg/svgdrawing/) to embed the actual box ID in a data attribute (e.g., data-box-id='id_1_l1_1') on every rendered SVG element. Update getBoxPrefix() to read from this attribute when available.
pros: Completely reliable - uses explicit stored data instead of parsing
Makes the mapping transparent and debuggable
Backward compatible - falls back to getBoxPrefix if attribute missing
cons: Requires changes in Go code (SVG rendering)
Requires coordination between Go backend and JavaScript frontend
Need to regenerate WASM after Go changes

alternatives.name: Use caption matching instead of ID parsing
alternatives.description: When blacklisting, match by caption text ('Master Node 1', 'VM 1') instead of parsing IDs. Store captions in blacklist and convert them to IDs on the Go side via a lookup mechanism.
pros: User-friendly - matches what user sees and clicks
cons: Fragile - captions can change, duplicate captions possible
Requires caption-to-ID mapping on Go side
May break if boxes have identical captions
Less explicit - harder to debug ID mismatches

recommendation.approach: Fix getBoxPrefix() logic + Store box ID in SVG data attributes (combined approach)
recommendation.rationale:
Start with approach #1 (fix getBoxPrefix) as a quick fix since it's low complexity. However, for long-term reliability and maintainability, also implement approach #3 (data attributes). This combination provides:

1. Immediate fix: Correct the getBoxPrefix() parsing logic to handle hierarchical IDs like 'id_1_l1_1' properly. The current implementation loses the 'l1' segment because it filters out non-numeric parts after the first number.

2. Long-term solution: Add explicit data-box-id attributes to SVG elements during rendering. This makes the system more robust and eliminates ambiguity.

3. Root cause: The issue occurs because:
   - SVG element IDs generated by the rendering layer are like 'id_1_l1_1_g' (the 'g' suffix indicates a group element)
   - getBoxPrefix() incorrectly extracts only numeric segments: 'id' + '1' + '1' = '1_1' (losing 'l1')
   - When 'id_1_1' is added to the blacklist, it matches the wrong boxes in the hierarchy

This dual approach balances quick fixes with architectural improvements.

notes: Issue confirmed: getBoxPrefix() at line 4077 of main.js is the culprit
The function splits by '_' and only keeps numeric parts after finding first numeric segment
Blacklist uses box IDs directly, so wrong ID extraction breaks filtering
Similar issue likely affects the expanded boxes collector as well
Test case URL provided: http://localhost:8080/?z=XIzBioQwEES_Ro_LJnr15Gm_... contains the test scenario with Master/Worker nodes and VMs
